# FerroWasp v0.1.0 — Experimental Foxeer F405 V2 Prototype

This is FerroWasp's first public pre-release. It is intended for developers,
researchers, and careful prototype testing. It is not a stable, certified,
airworthy, or production flight stack.

## Highlights

- Foxeer F405 V2 is the golden flight application.
- Four-lane DShot600 is the standard ESC output, with guarded arming,
  command-freshness containment, and legacy UART eRPM qualification.
- The standard Foxeer image includes USB CDC, persistent configuration,
  onboard SPI-NOR blackbox logging, ESC telemetry, SBUS, runtime IMU detection,
  and DJI O4 MSP DisplayPort OSD.
- RTIC applications are thin wiring shells. Reusable behavior lives in shared
  crates, while board pin, peripheral, DMA, timer, and orientation facts remain
  isolated in board support.
- FerroConfigurator provides a manifest-verified Windows workflow for USB DFU
  flashing, configuration management, blackbox download, and ULog conversion.

## Ready Package

Download both:

- `ferrowasp-v0.1.0-windows-x86_64.zip`
- `ferrowasp-v0.1.0-windows-x86_64.zip.sha256`

Verify the ZIP checksum before extracting it. The package contains the exact
Foxeer firmware ELF, a manifest with its Git commit and SHA-256, the
configurator, reviewed DFU tooling, licences, and corresponding third-party
source.

See the
[Foxeer F405 V2 guide](https://github.com/Eirik2020/ferro-wasp/blob/v0.1.0/mdbook/src/user/foxeer_f405_v2.md)
before flashing. Remove all propellers and keep the ESC power rail disconnected
during USB maintenance.

## Important Limitations

- DShot pulse timing, cross-timer phase, jitter, and physical stop latency still
  require complete target-instrumentation evidence.
- Independent actuator-deadline detection for total loss of future
  control-loop commands is not complete.
- Estimator, controller, fault-injection, and airframe-specific tuning coverage
  remains prototype-level.
- Firmware and configuration compatibility may change in later `0.x`
  pre-releases.

The full support matrix and open limitations are maintained in
[Current Support](https://github.com/Eirik2020/ferro-wasp/blob/v0.1.0/mdbook/src/current_support.md).
